blocker.observed: expected HTTP 409 detail containing 'Processamento ocupado', got 'Documento preservado falhou na validação específica; nenhuma revisão foi aprovada.'
blocker.cause: ProcessingError subclasses ValueError; review_cases.py prepare() catches ValueError at line 209 before ProcessingError at line 211, so concurrency_limit is misclassified as parser validation and the actionable processing error is masked.
blocker.required_fix: Handle ProcessingError before ValueError (or exclude it from the ValueError handler), preserving 409 while retaining the specific busy-processing response; rerun the failed regression and directed APTA suite.
